source.original_text: For every natural n, including zero, and every real symmetric positive-definite n by n precision matrix A, the actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2). The exponent n/2 is real division. Coordinates are WithLp.ofLp of the genuine Euclidean vector. No density, Jacobian, inverse, square-root or normalization fact is assumed beyond A.PosDef. This is a standard background generalization used by the source density assertion.

decoder_context: EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its canonical inner product and volume; WithLp.ofLp gives coordinates, and squared Euclidean norm is the sum of coordinate squares. The default coordinate Pi sup norm is not substituted.

For covariance C, multivariateGaussian zero C is the existing measure (stdGaussian E).map (fun z => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z), where stdGaussian is the canonical centered unit-covariance standard Gaussian on this Euclidean space. CFC.sqrt is the actual positive-semidefinite matrix square root on nonnegative self-adjoint matrices.

A.PosDef means real Hermitian symmetry and strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero coordinate vector; inverse is the existing nonsingular matrix inverse. No asserted density or normalization is built into this predicate.

volume.withDensity f is the measure whose integrals use the displayed nonnegative extended-real density f; ENNReal.ofReal is the nonnegative extended-real embedding of a real value. Equality means equality of measures. All real powers use real division n/2 and Real.sqrt is nonnegative.

objects.original: The actual canonical centered Gaussian with covariance A inverse; canonical Euclidean volume; SPD precision A; exact determinant-normalized quadratic exponential density.
objects.reconstructed: Centered Gaussian on real Euclidean n-space with covariance A inverse, realized using the canonical standard Gaussian and covariance square root; the displayed exact density relative to canonical volume.
objects.evidence: The current theorem uses ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian, not a local replacement. Mathlib Multivariate.lean:168 defines this by mapping stdGaussian through mean plus Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt S). Here S=A inverse and the mean is zero. WithLp.ofLp provides only coordinates. The density uses the actual matrix determinant, Real.sqrt, Real.exp and ENNReal.ofReal.

domains.original: Every natural n including zero; real Fin n by Fin n matrix A and genuine EuclideanSpace over R with Fin n coordinates.
domains.reconstructed: Every natural dimension n; real n by n positive-definite matrix and real n-dimensional Euclidean space.
domains.evidence: The implicit binder {n : N} is universal, with no lower bound or Nonempty Fin n premise. The ambient measure has type Measure (EuclideanSpace R (Fin n)), hence its norm is the L2 norm. Mathlib PosDef is Hermitian plus strictly positive quadratic form; on real finite matrices this is ordinary symmetric positive definiteness. The reconstruction saying every natural number includes zero.

quantifiers.original: For every natural n and every real SPD precision matrix A, the measure identity holds.
quantifiers.reconstructed: For every natural n and every real n by n positive-definite A, the stated equality holds.
quantifiers.evidence: The public theorem binds only {n : N}, A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R and hA : A.PosDef. There is no existential covariance, density, normalizer, Jacobian or chosen basis in its public hypotheses/conclusion. The private helper existentially constructs an actual invertible Euclidean linear map inside the proof.

assumptions.original: Only A.PosDef, with the standard canonical Euclidean and Gaussian structures; no assumed density, inverse, square-root, determinant, normalization or change-of-variables identity.
assumptions.reconstructed: A is symmetric and its quadratic form is positive on every nonzero real vector; canonical square-root Gaussian construction is specified.
assumptions.evidence: The entire module has no section variable, local instance or extra axiom adding a theorem hypothesis. Matrix.PosDef at LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosDef.lean:161 and its finite dotProduct characterization expose exactly symmetry and strict positivity. PosDef.inv, positivity of determinants, CFC square-root laws, linear invertibility, Euclidean norm conversion, Jacobian, standard density and real-power conversions are derived inside the proof or obtained from proved dependencies.

conclusion.original: N(0,A inverse) equals Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A)/(2*pi)^((n:R)/2) times exp(-(x transpose A x)/2).
conclusion.reconstructed: The same equality of measures, with the real density embedded into nonnegative extended reals.
conclusion.evidence: The RHS is volume.withDensity of ENNReal.ofReal of precisely that product. The coordinate dot product is (WithLp.ofLp x) dot (A mulVec WithLp.ofLp x). hnorm identifies the genuine Euclidean inverse-image norm square with this quadratic form. hdetfactor gives sqrt(det A), hnormalizer uses real division and real exponentiation, and the final withDensity_congr_ae follows pointwise equality. This is a measure equality, with no unproved Radon-Nikodym density assumption.

scopes.original: A standard all-SPD Gaussian background identity expanded to every natural dimension, used by the source density assertion; not an all-matrices theorem attributed to the paper.
scopes.reconstructed: The general background measure identity on all real finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces, including the canonical covariance-square-root semantics.
scopes.evidence: The anonymous reconstruction makes no paper attribution. Raw source Eq4 defines only A_O=(kappa+1)I/2-(kappa-1)(O+O transpose)/4. Appendix B.2 restricts n>=3, kappa>=4 and full Haar O(n), introduces p_O as density of N(0,A_O inverse), and B.2.2 uses its determinant Gaussian factor. Eq26 and symmetry supply SPD for these matrices. The candidate source attribution, lesson source scope and public module header explicitly identify the generic identity including n=0 as standard background generalization. The separate source adapter derives SPD and consumes this theorem. No separation, mixture, total-variation or query-complexity result follows merely from this identity.

constant_dependencies.original: The exact coefficient sqrt(det A)/(2*pi)^(n/2), with n/2 in R, and exponent minus one half of the precision quadratic form; no hidden arbitrary constants.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Identical fixed determinant, pi, dimension-half and exponent coefficients; nonnegative real square root.
constant_dependencies.evidence: The theorem literally has Real.sqrt A.det / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : R) / 2). The proof converts the natural-power standard density coefficient using Real.rpow_natCast, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow and Real.rpow_mul at positive base 2*pi. The Jacobian uses the inverse absolute determinant, then positivity removes the absolute value. For n=0 the determinant is the empty determinant 1, the quadratic sum is zero, the power exponent is zero, and the density is 1.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.IsotropicGaussianDensity
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Lebesgue.EqHaar
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Determinant
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Canonical volume density of a Gaussian with SPD precision

Standard nondegenerate Gaussian background, including dimension zero. The actual
existing multivariateGaussian covariance-square-root pushforward is identified
with the exact precision density. No new Gaussian constructor is introduced.
-/

open Matrix MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped MatrixOrder
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.IsotropicGaussianDensity
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.RadonNikodym

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianPrecisionDensity

private lemma exists_matrix_linearEquiv {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hB : B.det ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∀ x, WithLp.ofLp (e x) = B *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) ∧
      (∀ x, WithLp.ofLp (e.symm x) = B⁻¹ *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) ∧
      LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap = B.det := by
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    { toLinearMap := Matrix.toEuclideanLin B
      invFun := Matrix.toEuclideanLin B⁻¹
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        apply WithLp.ofLp_injective
        change B⁻¹ *ᵥ (B *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) = WithLp.ofLp x
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hB),
          Matrix.one_mulVec]
      right_inv := by
        intro x
        apply WithLp.ofLp_injective
        change B *ᵥ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) = WithLp.ofLp x
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hB),
          Matrix.one_mulVec] }
  refine ⟨e, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  change LinearMap.det (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) = B.det
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal]
  exact LinearMap.det_toLin _ _

theorem multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_posDef {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A⁻¹ =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).withDensity (fun x =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt A.det / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2))) := by
  classical
  let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := CFC.sqrt A⁻¹
  have hAi : A⁻¹.PosDef := hA.inv
  have hBd : B.det = Real.sqrt A⁻¹.det := by
    simpa only [B, RCLike.sqrt_of_nonneg hAi.posSemidef.det_nonneg, RCLike.re_to_real,
      RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq] using
      hAi.posSemidef.det_sqrt
  have hBpos : 0 < B.det := by rw [hBd]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hAi.det_pos
  have hBpsd : B.PosSemidef := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A⁻¹).posSemidef
  have hBsq : B * B = A⁻¹ := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self A⁻¹ hAi.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hBinvsq : B⁻¹ * B⁻¹ = A := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hBsq,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne')]
  have hBts : (B⁻¹).transpose = B⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv,
      (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hBpsd.isHermitian)]
  obtain ⟨e, he, hei, hedet⟩ := exists_matrix_linearEquiv B hBpos.ne'
  let em : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    e.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
  have hnorm (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
      ‖em.symm x‖ ^ 2 = (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) := by
    calc
      _ = (WithLp.ofLp (e.symm x)) ⬝ᵥ (WithLp.ofLp (e.symm x)) := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
        simp only [dotProduct, pow_two]
        rfl
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hei, dotProduct_comm, ← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec,
          hBts, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBinvsq]
  have hdetfactor : |(B.det)⁻¹| = Real.sqrt A.det := by
    rw [hBd, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Real.sqrt_inv, inv_inv,
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  have hmap : (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).map em =
      ENNReal.ofReal |(B.det)⁻¹| • volume := by
    change (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).map e.toLinearMap = _
    simpa only [hedet] using
      (Measure.map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        (f := e.toLinearMap) (by rw [hedet]; exact hBpos.ne'))
  have hstd : stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).withDensity (fun x =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ n * Real.exp (-‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2))) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one, one_smul, Measure.map_id', mul_one,
      finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin] using
      (map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity (E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (1 : ℝ) zero_lt_one)
  have hnormalizer : ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ n =
      1 / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) := by
    rw [inv_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
      ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)]
    simp only [show (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (n : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) / 2 by ring, one_div]
  have hem : (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) B x) =
      (em : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    funext x
    apply WithLp.ofLp_injective
    exact (he x).symm
  rw [multivariateGaussian]
  simp only [zero_add]
  change (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).map (fun x => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) B x) = _
  rw [hem]
  rw [hstd, measurableEquiv_map_withDensity em volume (by fun_prop), hmap,
    withDensity_smul_measure, ← withDensity_smul _ (by fun_prop)]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    change ENNReal.ofReal |(B.det)⁻¹| *
      ENNReal.ofReal (((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ n *
        Real.exp (-‖em.symm x‖ ^ 2 / 2)) = _
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _), hdetfactor, hnorm, hnormalizer]
    congr 1
    ring

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianPrecisionDensity

steps.title: Take the actual covariance square root
steps.text: Set B to the canonical positive-semidefinite square root of A inverse. SPD gives positive determinant of A inverse. Its square root has positive determinant, B squared equals A inverse, and the inverse square satisfies B inverse times B inverse equals A.
steps.lean: hAi, hBd, hBpos, hBpsd, hBsq and hBinvsq use actual PosDef.inv, CFC square root, determinant square-root and nonsingular matrix inverse APIs.

steps.title: Build the reversible Euclidean change of variables
steps.text: The private linear-equivalence provider turns the invertible matrix B into an actual real Euclidean linear equivalence e. Its action and inverse action have exactly the matrix coordinate formulas; its linear determinant equals det B. The canonical volume Jacobian is therefore the inverse absolute determinant.
steps.lean: exists_matrix_linearEquiv proves both inverse laws by nonsingular inverse multiplication and the determinant using the canonical orthonormal basis. hmap uses the actual map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar on Euclidean volume.

steps.title: Reuse the same standard Gaussian density
steps.text: Instantiate the existing canonical isotropic Gaussian density theorem at variance one. This identifies the actual stdGaussian with the standard Euclidean volume density, including the zero-dimensional singleton.
steps.lean: hstd calls exactly map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity at eta=1 and simplifies the identity pushforward. No new Gaussian measure is defined.

steps.title: Identify the true Euclidean quadratic form
steps.text: The inverse square root is symmetric. Expand the actual Euclidean squared norm as the sum of coordinate squares and use transpose/matrix multiplication to obtain x transpose A x. The coordinate map is used only for coordinates; no isometry to a default Pi sup norm is asserted.
steps.lean: hBts uses real Hermitian symmetry. hnorm explicitly uses EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq and coordinate dotProduct, then hei, dotProduct_transpose_mulVec and hBinvsq.

steps.title: Compute the exact dimension and determinant factors
steps.text: Positive definiteness makes all square-root and real-power conversions legitimate. The inverse determinant factor is sqrt(det A), and the standard Gaussian coefficient is precisely (2pi) to the real power minus n/2. Dimension zero is retained.

lesson.lean_statement: For every natural n, including zero, and every real symmetric positive-definite n by n precision matrix A, the actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2). The exponent n/2 is real division. Coordinates are WithLp.ofLp of the genuine Euclidean vector. No density, Jacobian, inverse, square-root or normalization fact is assumed beyond A.PosDef. This is a standard background generalization used by the source density assertion.

reconstruction.text: For every natural number n and every real n-by-n positive-definite matrix A (symmetric, with strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero vector), the centered Gaussian measure on real n-dimensional Euclidean space with covariance A inverse equals the measure with density sqrt(det A) / (2 pi)^(n/2) times exp(-(x transpose A x)/2) with respect to canonical Euclidean volume. The Gaussian measure here is the pushforward of the canonical standard Gaussian under the linear map given by the positive-semidefinite square root of A inverse. The exponent n/2 uses real division, and the square root is the nonnegative real square root. The equality is equality of measures; the displayed real density is embedded in the nonnegative extended reals.
